card.name: The word on after effect(s)
card.fires_on: The word "on" (rarely "the" after "on") right after "effect" or "effects", as in "Effects on Fertility" or "drug effect on suicide". Also fires on "on" in headings like "Other Drugs on [drug]".

modes.label: Effects on heading
modes.description: "on" after "Effects" at the start of a label section heading.
modes.example: Effects<< on>> Fertility The use of ketorol

modes.label: Drug effect on outcome
modes.description: "on" after "drug effect" in running text about trial conclusions.
modes.example: any conclusion about drug effect<< on>> suicide. The increased risk of suicidal thoughts

modes.label: Drug interaction heading
modes.description: "on" in headings about one drug acting on another.
modes.example: Other Drugs<< on>> CAMZYOS Strong CYP2C

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for what is affected, such as behaviour, morale, psyche and performance.
card.plain: It marks the little word "on" after "effect", where the text is about to name what is being affected.
